By leveraging AI/ML and integrating multiple sensors and mitigation technologies into a single operating picture, Dedrone enables customers to detect, track, identify, analyse and respond to drone activity. Solutions can be deployed on-premise, in air-gapped environments or in the cloud, supporting demanding defence, national security, public safety and critical-infrastructure missions.

 

This role will drive Dedrone’s growth across Central & Eastern Europe (CEE), with a particular focus on Poland, Czech Republic, Bulgaria, Romania, Slovakia, Hungary. The region is experiencing rapidly evolving security requirements and increasing demand for counter-UAS and airspace-awareness capabilities across defence, border security, critical infrastructure and public safety.

 

Location: Poland (Remote)

• Own market development, sales planning and revenue growth across Central & Eastern European markets, with particular focus on Defence, National Security, Public Safety and Critical Infrastructure.

• Develop and execute country-specific go-to-market strategies reflecting local defence procurement structures, security priorities, regulatory environments and customer requirements.

• Build and expand relationships with defence ministries, armed forces, border and security agencies, police and public safety organisations, critical-infrastructure operators and other government stakeholders.

• Navigate complex government and defence procurement processes and develop opportunities from initial customer engagement and capability definition through demonstrations, trials, tenders and contract award.

• Position Dedrone solutions within broader C2, sensor, radar, electronic warfare, security and counter-UAS architectures, working with customers and partners to address operational requirements.

• Develop strategies and tactics to maximise opportunities created through existing Axon relationships, capabilities and networks across government, public safety and commercial markets.
